items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: I didn't know much about him, but I, I remember the time, you know, when he, when he did do all that killing.

ctx.x: Seems to me Gino told me about somebody. We can ask him about it. Uh-huh. Somebody with a similar name, maybe a relative or something. Do you remember Jip the Blood when they had that killing?
Oh, yes. That's, that's, that's, that's, uh, I didn't know much about him, but I, I remember the time, you know, when he, when he did do all that killing.
Well, what happened after the killing? Did things go on as normal or they closed down or what?
